name: hero-mode
description: Hero Mode — Heroes aren't born. They're forged.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run sync-www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios

author: Cody Flowers

_notes.ads: Add @capacitor-community/admob when AdMob account is ready. Bundle ID must match capacitor.config.json appId.
_notes.iap: Add com.revenuecat.purchases:purchases-capacitor (RevenueCat) OR native Google Billing / StoreKit. RevenueCat recommended for unified iOS+Android IAP.
_notes.analytics: Add @capacitor-firebase/analytics if Firebase is set up for crash reporting + funnel analysis.
